title: Jack Carey at Suburban
summary: He worked with Jack Carey in a four-piece band at Suburban, where Carey lived.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Any other bands that you can pick of that you played with or musicians or any other jobs you had for a while? Where have you been playing in recent years before you had this present job?
All different places. It's all over I guess. It's all over. It's all over.
You know what I want to ask you something you might know, plenty of people whom we've talked to, they don't ever say too much about Jack Carey, a trombone player.
Old man Jack? Yeah. I worked with Jack Carey at-
That's a man who had three and four bands or-

Yeah, I worked with Jack Carey at Seussberry. He's a child. Old man Jack Carey, I worked with him at Seussberry. What kind of trombone player was? It's a pretty good trombone player with me and Jack. He had three bands one night.
I worked out there with him.
Two or three numbers, then he'd go over there.

I worked out there with him, me, Jack Carey, Lil' Lawrence, and Emil Raleigh. It was four pieces, no saxophone. Just trombone, cornet, and banjo, and drum. At that time they had no guitar. It wasn't used to no guitar, I mean at that time, banjo. Old man Jack Carey, yeah sure, tall, slim, he was living in Seussberry.
Nobody would ever mention him much. Yeah, he shouldn't be mentioned though. I was small, I couldn't have a tie in this thing.
He lived way out there in Jefferson.
No, no, Seussberry, he lived in Seussberry. He died, he'd been there a good while now. He was old, he was one of them old timers.
You know, we were talking about him last night, Professor Mineta, said he lived up around Louisiana Avenue a block from there. Who that? That's where I knew him.

Who that, Jack? Yeah, right. Jack Carey. He bought a house in Seussberry. You know where the hour club is? Yeah. You live by three doors from the hour club. I was there. Three doors from the hour club.
